environment: Separate clean Git clone and research Python environment on the same machine. Public benchmark inputs reconstructed from pinned source files.
paper_checks: All four tables were independently calculated from per-assignment records. The confidence bounds were checked with numerical likelihood optimization and the cost bounds with a separate paired bootstrap calculation.
Eight references, all cross references, the plain-text abstract and PDF metadata were checked. All five rendered pages were inspected.
Both source archives compiled offline with pdfLaTeX (TeX Live 2025) and disabled shell escape. A fixed build epoch yielded byte-identical PDFs, source ZIPs and metadata.
